title: Jawaan bete ka lasha uthake laaye hussain
body:
Jawaan bete ka laasha uthake laaye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kaise zayeefi me dukh uthaaye hussain
<<MINI>>
Jawaan bete ka laasha uthake laaye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Sadaye Aaqri sunkar Hussain run ko chale
Gire kabhi kabhi, uthkar Hussain run ko chale
Sarhane baith ke , zaanu pa sar uthaye Hussain
<<MINI>>
Jawaan bete ka laasha uthake laaye Hussain......
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Pidar ke aane ki aahat suni jo Akbar ne
Tadap ke rehgaye aur Aah ki na Akbar ne
Pisar ko dekhke , kya zakhm dil pa khaye Hussain
<<MINI>>
Jawaan bete ka laasha uthake laaye Hussain......
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Pidar yeh aaya hai kuch tou kaho Ali Akbar
Yeh haath seene pa kyu'n rakhe ho Ali Akbar
Utho ke seene se, apne tumhe lagaye Hussain
<<MINI>>
Jawaan bete ka laasha uthake laaye Hussain......
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Nikaali shaah ne kehkar jo ya Ali barchi
Pidar ke aage pisar ne li Aaqri hichki
Uthaye naaz the laashe ko ab uthaye Hussain
<<MINI>>
Jawaan bete ka laasha uthake laaye Hussain......
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Qareeb e lashaye Akbar jo aagayi zainab
Pisar ke qoone jigar me naha gayi zainab
Bahen ne kaise tere housle badhaye Hussain
<<MINI>>
Jawaan bete ka laasha uthake laaye Hussain......
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Jo laayi Qaime me sarwar ne laash Akbar ki
Tha hashr Bibiyo me aur ghash hui Maa bhi
Na jaane Quvvat e dil kaise Aazmaye Hussain
<<MINI>>
Jawaan bete ka laasha uthake laaye Hussain......
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Thi baade karbobala Maa ki yun basar HYDER
Azaan jab bhi suni yaad agaye Akbar
Yeh sadme zainabe muztar ne bhi uthaye Hussain
